verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents percentage rollouts and gradual-rollout rules that can be ramped and scheduled, including an optional release plan that ramps automatically. It also documents deterministic assignment, where the same attributes always produce the same variation across SDKs. Because flags are served as a cacheable JSON payload and evaluated locally, with streaming updates, ramps take effect without a redeploy. Missing for 10: explicit docs that users stay bucketed as the percentage grows from 1% to 100%, hands-on corroboration of a real ramp, and clarity that automated ramp schedules are a higher-tier paid feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying
